# Calculus II: Integration & Multivariate Calculus

Session 4 covers integration, the fundamental theorem of calculus, and an
introduction to multivariate calculus (partial derivatives, gradients, and
their application to deriving OLS).

This session has two parts:

- **[Slides](slides.qmd)** — the in-class slideshow.
- **[Programming Lecture](programming.qmd)** — a webpage walking through the
  same material with runnable R code.
